hydraulic.MA_tradeoff_scope: AUC recomputed; reliance rho from saved selection (no model traversal). MA0/common use only recomputed AP.

stage2_reuse.scope: 140 ensemble prediction files and two separate 30-seed mechanisms, each with 18 Holm tests and 20000 whole-seed-vector bootstrap. This run verifies fingerprints rather than retraining or rerunning all Stage2 arithmetic.

or3.scope: Recalculated statistics from stored 20000 x 5 contrast matrices; not regenerated row-weight predictions. sup-t across val/test remains auxiliary, joint resampling coverage unproven.
